editorial: Imagine waking up every single morning as a complete stranger. One day you are an old man, the next you are a child, or maybe a woman from another country. That is exactly what happens to Woo-jin, a talented furniture designer who lives a very lonely life because of this strange curse. Then he meets Yi-soo, and for the first time, he finds someone who loves him for who he is on the inside, regardless of what he looks like. It is a sweet, dreamy story that feels like a warm hug, focusing on the idea that true love goes deeper than skin.
endingExplained: You will find out that Yi-soo is actually blind, which is why she could love Woo-jin without seeing his changing face. In the end, Woo-jin finally finds a way to stop changing bodies. He wakes up as one permanent person, and it turns out to be the version of him that Yi-soo had grown to love most. They get to be together in a stable way, proving that their emotional bond was the real cure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves unique romance stories and emotional dramas.
